steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: design.optimize-loop, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {model: "rosenbrock", start: [-1.2, 1], method: "nelder-mead"}, target optimize → PASS with x ≈ (1, 1) to 1e-3, objective < 1e-6, converged true — the Rosenbrock minimum from the classic start, a known-by-mathematics case, never the solver's self-report alone; the quadratic anchor checks beside it (minimizer known by construction, b = A·x*, pinned to 1e-4).

Honesty + Pareto leg: every run declares its evaluation budget, and exhaustion or non-convergence serves the best point found WITH a warning — never dressed as an optimum; a start outside its bounds refuses by name. Pareto replay: {model: "car-mass-range"}, target pareto → the non-dominated front (min mass, max range), recomputed independently in the suite from the declared pack constants (specific energy 0.25 kWh/kg, glider 900 kg, consumption 0.12 + 6e-5·mass kWh/km) and checked point-by-point for dominance — nothing dominated is served; the front is built by weighted scalarization PLUS a dense parameter sweep, because for this one-parameter family the front is the model curve and weighted sums alone recovered only 3 distinct points in the build's measurement. Gradient-method leg: Barzilai–Borwein steps safeguarded by Armijo backtracking — plain steepest descent, measured zigzagging to the budget on an ill-conditioned quadratic while sitting 3e-9 from the minimizer, must not reappear as the shipped method.

Engine-tier leg: target engine → NOT_COMPUTED requires_engine_tier:sxe-21 — adjoint gradients, arbitrary chain objectives, and the engine optimizers (HiGHS/IPOPT class) are SXE-21's scope, refused by name, never approximated in JS; with the engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-21 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 / negative-where-physical-positive input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a polynomial model declaring total degree > 4 → refused naming the bound; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
